summary.business_type: Publisher / catalog (TV & film tracking app, programmatic TMDB pages + user reviews)
top_findings: Cloudflare returns 403 to answer-engine bots (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Claude-SearchBot, MistralAI-User) while robots.txt declares Content-Signal search=yes
~1M episode URLs in 40+ low-resource languages are indexable template pages without episode title/summary (193-214 words)
Flutter payload 4.1 MB on desktop; on throttled mobile the engine has not loaded within 12 s (TBT 552 ms desktop)
Dynamic rendering by User-Agent is the single point of failure for indexing
Sub-sitemaps not edge-cached (DYNAMIC); uncompressed 3.2 MB / 10-27 s
quick_wins: Allow answer-engine bots in Cloudflare AI Crawl Control (keep training bots blocked)
Add og:image/twitter:image to SSR homepage and language homepages
Cut meta descriptions at sentence boundary instead of '…'
Fix translation leaks (sw company page Turkish fragment, untranslated genres, 'AI özeti' on /en)
Cloudflare Cache Rule for /sitemap*.xml (1h edge TTL)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 301s for http/www/trailing slash/uppercase; canonical strips query
robots.txt served by Node; sensitive surfaces disallowed
Bots get 404 for missing pages; SSR TTFB 0.30-0.41 s

findings.title: Sitemap lists 1,316,781 URLs; episode family ~1.2M across 46 languages
findings.description: GSC memory: episode family ~4% indexed. User decision (5 Sep) keeps all 46 languages; monitor gap between submitted and indexed.
findings.recommendation: Apply content-based noindex gate (see Content #1) rather than language-based cuts; watch indexed/submitted ratio.

findings.title: Dynamic rendering by User-Agent is the only path to indexable HTML
findings.description: Human UA receives 12.9 KB Flutter shell with generic title; bots receive SSR. nginx bot regex is a single point of failure (3 Sep regex bug dropped SEO tools to shell).
findings.recommendation: Add regression test for the UA matrix after every deploy; long-term serve SSR to everyone with Flutter hydrating on top.

findings.title: Human UA gets HTTP 200 for non-existent paths (soft 404)
findings.description: /olmayan-sayfa-xyz123 returns 200 + shell for humans; Googlebot gets 404.
findings.recommendation: Return 404 status with the shell or an nginx 404 page for unknown routes.

findings.title: Sub-sitemaps not cached at the edge
findings.description: cf-cache-status DYNAMIC; gzip 123 KB/1.0 s, uncompressed 3.2 MB/10-27 s.
findings.recommendation: Cloudflare Cache Rule: /sitemap*.xml eligible, 1h edge TTL.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: Bot UA 404, human UA shell 200. Optional; ignored by Google.
findings.recommendation: Optional: serve plain text on the SSR route.

findings.title: document.title stays 'dizi.jpg' on every page in the Flutter app
findings.description: Playwright: title unchanged after render on / and /icerik/tv/1405.
findings.recommendation: Set page title from Flutter router for bookmarks/sharing.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Series/movie/person pages 400-950 words with plot, FAQ, dated user reviews, labelled AI summary
QRG content scorer 84-96, no filler/AI-pattern flags
Person pages already noindex when biography missing in that language

findings.title: Episode pages in low-resource languages are template filler
findings.description: /sw, /am, /hi episode pages: no episode title or summary (no TMDB translation); 193-214 words all boilerplate; indexable and in sitemap (~1M URLs).
findings.recommendation: Content gate identical to person pages: if episode title OR summary missing in that language → noindex,follow and drop from sitemap. Not a language cut; tr/en/de unaffected.

findings.title: Translation leaks
findings.description: /sw/sirket/4343 contains Turkish 'Öne çıkan yapımları:'; genres untranslated on sw/am series pages; '@dizi.jpg.ai dizi.jpg AI özeti' Turkish on /en.
findings.recommendation: Add leak scan across 46 languages for Turkish tokens; translate genre names.

findings.recommendation: Truncate at sentence boundary.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Inline splash screen gives FCP ~1 s on throttled mobile

findings.title: Flutter payload 4.1 MB; engine not loaded within 12 s on throttled mobile
findings.description: canvaskit.wasm 2.9 MB + skwasm.wasm 1.5 MB + main.dart.js. Desktop: load 4.7 s, 8 long tasks, TBT 552 ms. Mobile (4x CPU, 1.6 Mb/s): only 4 resources/37 KB after 12 s.
findings.recommendation: Ship a single renderer variant; deferred imports for login/chat/media editor/collage; re-measure with the same Playwright script.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Clean CSS-less SSR HTML with <dl> FAQs, dates, numbers, source attribution

findings.title: Answer-engine bots blocked with 403 at Cloudflare
findings.description: OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Claude-SearchBot, MistralAI-User → 403 'Your request was blocked' (server: cloudflare, no origin headers). robots.txt only disallows training bots and declares search=yes.
findings.recommendation: Cloudflare AI Crawl Control: allow answer/search bots; keep GPTBot/ClaudeBot/CCBot/Bytespider blocked. Verify with UA matrix → 200.
